removed_ids = set(b_nodes)-set(a_nodes)
print('new ids', new_ids)
print('removed ids', removed_ids)
changed = []
for nid in set(b_nodes)&set(a_nodes):
    bn = b_nodes[nid]
    an = a_nodes[nid]
    if bn['pixels']!=an['pixels'] or bn['color']!=an['color'] or bn['hash']!=an['hash']:
        changed.append(nid)
print('changed ids', changed)
# check bottom row
print('row63 before', b_lines[63])
print('row63 after', a_lines[63])
